title: Action verbs: moving and handling
theme: verbs for movement, handling objects and changes of state
goal: Recognise and use 24 everyday verbs for moving, handling things and switching them off or on.

example.fr: Ne bouge pas, je prends la photo !
example.en: Don't move, I'm taking the picture!

example.fr: Il a foncé vers la sortie.
example.en: He rushed towards the exit.

example.fr: Le chien s'est enfui du jardin.
example.en: The dog ran away from the garden.

items.en: to chase; to continue; to sue

example.fr: Elle veut poursuivre ses études à Ottawa.
example.en: She wants to continue her studies in Ottawa.

example.fr: N'oublie pas d'emporter un parapluie.
example.en: Don't forget to take an umbrella.

items.en: to send back; to fire (from a job)

example.fr: J'ai renvoyé le colis au vendeur.
example.en: I sent the parcel back to the seller.

items.en: to find again; to meet up with

example.fr: J'ai retrouvé mes clés sous le sofa.
example.en: I found my keys under the sofa.

example.fr: L'application peut localiser ton téléphone.
example.en: The app can locate your phone.

items.en: to pull out, to tear off

example.fr: Le dentiste m'a arraché une dent.
example.en: The dentist pulled out one of my teeth.

example.fr: Accroche ton manteau à l'entrée.
example.en: Hang your coat up at the entrance.

example.fr: Colle la photo sur la carte.
example.en: Stick the photo on the card.

items.en: to jam, to wedge, to trap

example.fr: Mon doigt s'est coincé dans la porte.
example.en: My finger got caught in the door.

example.fr: On va peindre la cuisine en jaune.
example.en: We're going to paint the kitchen yellow.

example.fr: J'ai effacé le message par erreur.
example.en: I deleted the message by mistake.

example.fr: Elle a balancé ses vieux vêtements.
example.en: She threw out her old clothes.

items.note: Informal in the sense "to throw out, to chuck" (neutral: jeter).

items.en: to cut down (tree), to knock down

example.fr: La ville a abattu les vieux arbres de la rue.
example.en: The city cut down the old trees on the street.

example.fr: Tu peux baisser le son, s'il te plaît ?
example.en: Can you turn the sound down, please?

items.en: to turn off, to put out

example.fr: Éteins la lumière en sortant.
example.en: Turn off the light when you leave.

example.fr: Elle a raccroché sans dire au revoir.
example.en: She hung up without saying goodbye.

example.fr: Enlève tes bottes avant d'entrer.
example.en: Take off your boots before you come in.

example.fr: Le ballon a éclaté.
example.en: The balloon burst.

items.note: éclater de rire = to burst out laughing

items.en: to crack; to give in, to break down

example.fr: J'ai craqué et j'ai mangé tout le chocolat.
example.en: I gave in and ate all the chocolate.

items.note: Informal in the sense "to give in, to crack": J’ai craqué ! Neutral sense: to crack, to creak.

example.fr: Il a failli se noyer dans le lac.
example.en: He nearly drowned in the lake.

items.en: to stay up; to watch over

example.fr: On a veillé tard pour voir le match.
example.en: We stayed up late to watch the game.

items.note: veiller sur quelqu’un = to look after someone

blocks.title: Switching off and changes of state
Usage tips
blocks.body:
- [[Éteindre]] and [[peindre]] share a pattern: [[j'éteins, il a éteint]] / [[je peins, il a peint]].
- [[S'enfuir]] and [[se noyer]] take être: [[il s'est enfui]].
- [[Renvoyer]] can also mean *to fire* someone.
- [[Craquer]] (informal) = to give in to temptation.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Repeat each sentence out loud, then record yourself and compare.

lines.fr: Ne bouge pas, je prends la photo !
lines.en: Don't move, I'm taking the picture!
Don't forget to take an umbrella.

Hang your coat up at the entrance.

lines.en: We're going to paint the kitchen yellow.

lines.en: I deleted the message by mistake.

lines.en: Can you turn the sound down, please?
Turn off the light when you leave.

lines.fr: Elle a raccroché sans dire au revoir.
lines.en: She hung up without saying goodbye.
Take off your boots before you come in.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Answer without scrolling back. Getting something wrong now helps you remember it later.

blocks.prompt: Your neighbour’s music is too loud. You ask:
blocks.explain: [[Baisser le son]] = to turn the sound down.

blocks.prompt: Which sentence is correct in the passé composé?
blocks.explain: Reflexive verbs like [[s’enfuir]] use être: [[il s’est enfui]].

blocks.prompt: Turn off the light. (to a friend)
blocks.explain: [[Éteindre]] → [[éteins]] for tu. In Québec you also hear [[Ferme la lumière]].

blocks.prompt: Take off your boots. (to a friend)

blocks.text: Elle a ___ sans dire au revoir.
blocks.en: She hung up without saying goodbye.
blocks.explain: [[Raccrocher]] = to hang up the phone; [[accrocher]] = to hang something on a hook.

blocks.text: Ce week-end, nous ___ la chambre en bleu. (peindre, futur proche)
blocks.en: This weekend, we're going to paint the bedroom blue.

blocks.fr: J'ai effacé le message par erreur.
On a veillé tard pour voir le match.
blocks.en: We stayed up late to watch the game.

summary:
- Talk about moving and finding: [[bouger, s’enfuir, emporter, retrouver]]
- Describe hands-on actions: [[accrocher, coller, peindre, effacer]]
- Turn things down and off: [[baisser le son, éteindre la lumière, raccrocher]]
